customer: Okay so this is kind of a mess, I'm a college student and I've been driving my parents' old full-size SUV around campus but honestly it's way too big and the gas is killing me, so I want to sell it to you. The thing is I just realized the registration expired a while back because I totally forgot about it with midterms and everything. I live in Texas, does that mean I can't sell it until I renew, or will it mess up the price you'd give me?
agent: No worries, you can still sell us the SUV with an expired registration, and it won't change the offer at all. Please bring the expired registration card with you anyway. The only state where the registration has to be current on the day of the sale is North Carolina, so being in Texas you're fine. If the SUV is registered in a different state from the one you live in, take a look at our article Selling a car registered in another state.
